text: Yili Industrial Group's 2025 annual report (30 Apr 2026) names Hohhot Investment Co., Ltd. as its largest shareholder with 538,535,826 shares, 8.51%, shareholder type 'state legal person' (国有法人), and states the company has no controlling shareholder and no actual controller.
